cards.name: [EPIC] Sprint 0 — Foundation & Governance
cards.desc:
# Objective
Establish the technical and organizational foundation of FlowDelivery.

# Scope
- Git workflow
- Conventional Commits
- MVVM architecture
- Supabase setup documentation
- Design System documentation
- Trello workflow
- Codex governance

# Release Target
v0.1.0

# Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Documentation created
- [x] Repository structure created
- [x] Initial validation passes
- [ ] Remaining implementation tasks mapped

cards.name: [FOUNDATION] Development workflow hardening
cards.desc:
# Objective
Strengthen the validation workflow before product features accelerate.

# Scope
- CI checks
- Analyzer discipline
- Test execution baseline
- PR review checklist

# Release Target
v0.1.x

# Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] CI expectations documented
- [ ] Local validation commands confirmed
- [ ] Review checklist aligned with Definition of Done

cards.name: [EPIC] User Authentication
cards.desc:
# Objective
Implement complete user authentication for the MVP.

# Features
- Login
- Sign up
- Password recovery
- Persistent session

# Release Target
v0.2.0

# Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] User can create an account
- [ ] User can log in and log out
- [ ] Session state survives app restart
- [ ] Auth failures show clear feedback

cards.name: [EPIC] Restaurant Feed
cards.desc:
# Objective
Create the main restaurant discovery experience.

# Features
- Categories
- Search
- Responsive cards
- Loading and empty states

# Release Target
v0.3.0

# Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Feed renders with mock or real data
- [ ] Search/filter states are handled
- [ ] UI follows design tokens
- [ ] View model boundaries stay clear

cards.name: [EPIC] Cart & Checkout
cards.desc:
# Objective
Implement the base ordering path.

# Features
- Cart management
- Checkout summary
- Address selection
- Mock payment

# Release Target
v0.4.0

# Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] User can add and remove items
- [ ] Totals are calculated consistently
- [ ] Checkout state is validated
- [ ] Failure and empty states are represented

cards.name: [EPIC] Order Tracking
cards.desc:
# Objective
Implement the order tracking experience after checkout.

# Features
- Order status lifecycle
- Timeline UI
- Status updates
- Tracking details

# Release Target
v0.5.0

# Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Status model defined
- [ ] Tracking screen implemented
- [ ] Data source boundary documented
- [ ] QA scenarios cover status changes

cards.name: [EPIC] User Profile
cards.desc:
# Objective
Create the user profile management area.

# Features
- Personal data
- Addresses
- Order history
- Favorites

# Release Target
v0.6.0

# Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Profile screen structure defined
- [ ] Address management planned
- [ ] Order history contract mapped
- [ ] Privacy-sensitive states reviewed

cards.name: [RELEASE] MVP Portfolio Release
cards.desc:
# Objective
Publish the first polished portfolio-ready version.

# Scope
- Android build
- Web build if supported
- README updated
- Screenshots or demo evidence
- QA checklist validated

# Release Target
v1.0.0

# Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Release scope closed
- [ ] Known issues documented
- [ ] QA evidence attached
- [ ] Portfolio narrative ready

cards.name: [RELEASE] Technical stabilization
cards.desc:
# Objective
Reserve a stabilization window before public portfolio sharing.

# Scope
- Bug triage
- Technical debt cleanup
- Documentation consistency
- Build validation

# Release Target
v1.0.0-rc

# Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Critical bugs closed
- [ ] High-impact debt reviewed
- [ ] Release notes drafted
- [ ] Final validation commands run

Future
